---
title: "Save a chart to a file"
---

Write one chart to an HTML page, an SVG image, and a PNG image.

## Code

The chart plots weight against fuel economy for the 32 cars of R's `mtcars` data, bundled with phiz as [`resources/data/mtcars.csv`](https://github.com/phpstats/phiz/blob/main/resources/data/mtcars.csv).

{{< include ../_generated/example-save-code.md >}}

Runnable script: [`save.php`](https://github.com/phpstats/phiz/blob/main/docs/examples/scripts/save.php) (PHP 8.5+) or [`save.chain.php`](https://github.com/phpstats/phiz/blob/main/docs/examples/scripts/save.chain.php) (PHP 8.3–8.4).

## Result

The SVG file:

{{< include ../_generated/example-save-output.md >}}

The file extension picks the format: `html` (or `htm`), `json` for the Vega-Lite specification, `svg`, `png`, `jpg` (or `jpeg`), or `pdf`.

- **HTML needs a network connection.** The page loads vega, vega-lite, and vega-embed from the jsDelivr CDN and draws the chart in the browser. [`Assets::inline()`](../rendering.qmd#library-sources-and-offline-pages) embeds the libraries for offline use.
- **Images need vl-convert.** The vl-convert binary renders SVG, PNG, JPG, and PDF without a browser. Without it, `save()` throws `VlConvertNotFound` ([Installing vl-convert](../rendering.qmd#installing-vl-convert)).
- **Images are static.** Tooltips and other interaction work only in the HTML file.
- **Image size.** An image has no page width to fill, so `size(640, 360)` sets its plot area in pixels. Without it, Vega-Lite's default size applies.
- **Reproducible SVG.** With the same vl-convert version, the same specification gives the same SVG bytes on every run, except for unseeded jitter ([Reproducible SVG](../rendering.qmd#reproducible-svg)).
